memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent with ADLs, walks 30 min daily, reports mild fatigue.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: no falls in last 12 months, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (methylcobalamin, sertraline, mebeverine, ispaghula husk, loperamide PRN, vitamin D). polypharmacy flag – review against Beers criteria.
mood: PHQ-2 0/2, denies low mood or anhedonia.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to stay active and keep my digestion settled."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Over the past month I’ve had more bloating after meals, loose stools twice a week, and I feel tired even after resting. My appetite is okay but I avoid dairy because it worsens the bloating.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: liver normal size, no focal lesions; gallbladder wall thickness 2 mm (normal); no biliary dilatation; kidneys unremarkable. No evidence of ascites or bowel wall thickening.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: ADL independent, walks 20 min daily, reports mild dyspnea on exertion.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (recall 3, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: one fall at home 3 months ago (slipped on wet floor), no injury; gait cautious, timed up-and-go 12 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise exercise and sturdy footwear.
medicines: 7 regular (added escitalopram). polypharmacy – medication review undertaken, stopped mirtazapine.
mood: PHQ-2 2/2, reports low mood and anhedonia for past 4 weeks.
carers: wife Priya, spouse.
goal: "I want to feel less down and keep my gut settled."
